mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% annualized, it signals persistent inflation that prompts monetary tightening expectations, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% annualized, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A three-month increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points indicates worsening labor market conditions that depress consumer confidence and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE increases by >0.5pp over 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in manufacturing output (INDPRO) and non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a severe economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both INDPRO and PAYEMS decline, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized), a rapid increase in the federal funds rate (exceeding 0.25 percentage points in one month) signals aggressive monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 500,000 units (HOUST < 500.0), it indicates deteriorating consumer demand that suppresses corporate revenue growth expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 500.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 90.0 (INDPRO < 90.0), it indicates a significant contraction in manufacturing output, depressing corporate earnings growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 90.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer credit (RSAFS) exceeds $375 billion (RSAFS > 375000.0), it indicates robust consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 375000.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% (UNRATE > 5.0%), it indicates a weak labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
